title: Taking money out of my account after paying for a year subscription...
body:
Paid for a yearly subscription (discounted apparently) and have still been charged weekly...!? I have sent an email and am waiting for a response. Please resolve this.

Update - after seeing a response to my initial review (months later) I reached out to the email they suggested only to be told that I may have accidentally selected the weekly subscription and that there is no way for them to verify that. 

The first payment that came out of my account was for $31.63 for what was supposed to be a discounted YEARLY subscription. I was then charged $11.85 weekly until Jan 20th (only noticed when logging in to pay bills). A total of $79.03 has been paid to this company for a subscription I didn’t even receive and instead of correcting it they will blame you for not catching it. So beware before you set this app to any subscription payments in your account.

Also, Apple wont do anything about it as it is more than 60 days past the last payment date.

I would give this app negative stars if it were possible.
